sloka: नानामृगाणामयुतं वध्यमानं महात्मना ।यत्र जातो माहासेनस्तं देशमुपचक्रमे ।। ७.८७.१० ॥
transliteration: nānāmṛgāṇāmayutaṁ vadhyamānaṁ mahātmanā ।yatra jāto māhāsenastaṁ deśamupacakrame ।। 7.87.10 ॥

translations.english: While ten thousand animals of various kinds were being killed by the great-souled king, he approached that region where Mahasena (Kartikeya) was born.
translations.hindi: ः प्रीतिश्वास्मिन परा जाता देवानां लवणे हते । भूतानां चेव सबेषं जगतश्च प्रियं कृतम्‌
